sentences.span: PMI-Composite printed 58.4 vs. 55.3 survey; 56.0 prior... Composite PMI rises to a 5-year high
sentences.why: JPM's Sept 24 morning briefing gives the exact flash composite print (58.4), survey (55.3) and prior (56.0), and separately calls it a 5-year high.

sentences.span: we would buy this dip through the broadening trade: yields are moving towards fair value (5.5%), similar episodes have historically been buying opportunities
sentences.why: JPM states the 5.5% fair-value yield call and the 'historically been buying opportunities' framing verbatim; '10-year' is a reasonable read of 'yields' given the doc's other references to 10y USTs and the market-wide convention (confirmed by two other same-window sources treating 5.5% as a 10-year level).

sentences.span: the peak in valuation for the S&P coincided with the 10-year yield's breach of 4.50%, the threshold we have long pointed to as the level at which rate sensitivity increases meaningfully for stocks
sentences.why: Morgan Stanley (Michael Wilson) names 4.50% as the rate-sensitivity trigger, and separately: 'a higher policy rate can reduce inflation uncertainty and term premium if it convinces investors that the Fed is acting early enough,' and 'raising it need not ensure higher long-term nominal financing costs.'

sentences.span: we are also seeing dispersion in the SPX: six straight days of more 52wk lows than highs even as the index has rallied back near all-time highs
sentences.why: BTIG's Jonathan Krinsky note (via Zero Hedge) states this exactly, six sessions of more new lows than highs alongside the index near record territory.

sentences.span: 13 of those 20 names made their 52wk highs AFTER March 14th... for those bullishly inclined we would focus on those names near new highs rather than the laggards
sentences.why: Matches the 13-of-20 SOX-constituent stat and BTIG's explicit recommendation to own new-high names over laggards.

sentences.span: Muse reached roughly 1.8 million iOS downloads across the US and Canada in its first 12 days, versus around 1.3 million for ChatGPT over a comparable period
sentences.why: UBS's note reports this Apptopia-sourced download comparison verbatim.

sentences.span: Net, I want to fade the move lower in banks and WM... I'd be patient and size accordingly rather than swinging at it. As flagged last week, favored names remain MS, PNC and FITB
sentences.why: Matches the trader's stance, sizing language, and preferred names exactly.

sentences.span: In a 'forever conflict' scenario, they conclude that Brent could average $87 in 2027, compared with $64 in their baseline scenario in which the world enters 2027 at peace
sentences.why: JPMorgan's Washington Policy Perspectives note attributes this directly to 'our commodity strategy team,' matching both figures and both scenarios.

sentences.span: The US Gulf Coast diesel crack spread cleared $100/bbl for the first time on record in August against a normal range of $15 to $30
sentences.why: Matches the crack-spread figure and normal range exactly; the input/pass-through mechanism is also stated near-verbatim in the same doc.

sentences.span: Diesel prices are averaging ~$6.52/gal vs. $2.83/gal a year ago, +230%
sentences.why: JPM's own briefing states this figure set verbatim, including the +230% label; the sentence reproduces the source's numbers exactly (the source's own arithmetic, not the pulse's, is what yields 230% against $6.52 vs $2.83).

sentences.span: overwhelming consensus from speakers that a Democratic House flip is a done deal, with the takeover put at 90% odds... Betting markets give the GOP only a 36% chance of holding the Senate
sentences.why: Both figures and both attributions (conference speakers vs. betting markets) match JPMorgan's note exactly.

sentences.span: Middle East tensions have pushed Brent into the $100-110/bbl range, above the $75-100/bbl band seen since late May
sentences.why: Exact match including the 'since late May' timing, from JPMorgan's note.

sentences.span: CTA flows go asymmetric into October. The systematic community is loaded to sell on the way down and barely a bid on the way up
sentences.why: Matches 'not symmetric' directly (asymmetric CTA/trend-follower flows), sourced to Goldman's desk data via The Market Ear.

sentences.span: If the rates move gets disorderly, small-cap vol is unlikely to stay this quiet. Russell vol looks like a cheap contagion hedge here
sentences.why: Matches the conditional (orderly vs. disorderly), the small-cap-vol consequence, and the cheap-hedge conclusion; 'contagion' supports 'spreading.'

sentences.span: this new backdrop should provide relief to bitcoin miners, thus reducing the risk of forced selling by them
sentences.why: JPMorgan's Flows & Liquidity note frames the mechanism precisely: miners below the implied production cost (underwater) face forced-selling risk; miners above it do not, once price clears production cost.
